name: Playwright MCP
summary: Microsoft's MCP server that gives an LLM browser control through Playwright. It works on accessibility-tree snapshots instead of screenshots, so a text-only model can click and type by element reference.
goodFor: Giving any MCP client a browser
Deterministic clicks without a vision model
watchOut: Snapshots can eat a lot of context
Microsoft points coding agents to Playwright CLI as a lighter option
